# How to choose a French SaaS translator

Choosing a French SaaS translator is not only about language quality. For product-led companies, the right partner should understand onboarding flows, feature pages, SEO intent and conversion copy.

## What to look for

- SaaS and B2B experience
- SEO awareness
- UX writing sensitivity
- Terminology management
- Localization QA experience

## Why it matters

French users can spot awkward product copy very quickly. A good localization workflow protects both trust and conversion.

content:
# French SEO translation checklist for SaaS teams

SEO translation is not a word-for-word exercise. It requires search intent analysis, keyword adaptation and careful on-page optimization.

## Checklist

- Adapt the title tag
- Rewrite the meta description
- Check the H1 and H2 structure
- Localize examples and pain points
- Add internal links
- Review CTA clarity

## Final check

A translated page should read like it was created for the French market from the start.
